title: Expose a manual Solana Helius CA-first read entrypoint
objective: Build one manually invoked, bounded Solana CA-first read entrypoint that composes the approved LiveHeliusDataSource into a safe structured first-look result. It must report only mint availability/decimals, metadata availability, holder-token-account count, completeness, source slots, and warnings. It must be usable for an owner-supplied CA, require runtime-only HELIUS_API_KEY, use Helius only, and never persist, enqueue deep analysis, start automation, or invoke AnalysisService repositories/caches.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, store, commit or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not call providers other than Helius and do not add a fallback.
Do not activate BSC, Robinhood, scheduler, cron, background loops, automated token discovery, deep-dive queue, or production database/cache writes.
Do not claim Pump creator, Dev history, address tags, wallet facts, wallet quality, holder concentration, or full deep analysis from this entrypoint.
